# sherpa-accordion

A disclosure card built on native &lt;details> / &lt;summary>. State IS the native `open` attribute — there is no data-expanded.

|  |  |
|---|---|
| Category | container |
| Built on | the native `<details>`, which gives toggle, open-state, keyboard |
| Figma | Accordion |
| Source | [.ts](../../src/components/sherpa-accordion/sherpa-accordion.ts) · [.html](../../src/components/sherpa-accordion/sherpa-accordion.html) · [.css](../../src/components/sherpa-accordion/sherpa-accordion.css) · [.component.json](../../src/components/sherpa-accordion/sherpa-accordion.component.json) · [.example.json](../../src/components/sherpa-accordion/sherpa-accordion.example.json) |

## Example

```html
<sherpa-accordion data-heading="Details"><p>More about this record.</p></sherpa-accordion>
```

## Attributes

| Attribute | Values | Default | What it does |
|---|---|---|---|
| `data-description` | text |  | optional secondary line under the title (fallback to slotted [slot=description]) |
| `data-heading` | text |  | the summary title (fallback to slotted [slot=heading]) |
| `data-icon` | text |  | a glyph before the title: what the section holds |
| `data-status` | text |  | status colour cascade (critical \| warning \| success \| info \| urgent) |
| `open` | boolean, native | `false` | native boolean (current disclosure state; drives [open] visuals) |

## Properties

| Property | Type | Access | What it is |
|---|---|---|---|
| `open` | `boolean` | read and write | whether the disclosure is expanded (delegates to &lt;details>) |

## Events

Each one bubbles.

| Event | Detail |
|---|---|
| `accordion-open` |  |
| `accordion-close` |  |

## Slots

| Slot | Accepts | What it holds |
|---|---|---|
| `heading` | text | rich summary title (overrides data-heading) |
| `description` | text | rich secondary line under the title (overrides data-description) |
| `actions` | control | trailing controls in the summary row, before the chevron. |
| (default) | content | the disclosure body |

## Parts

Style these from outside with `::part()`:

`actions`, `body`, `description`, `header`, `heading`, `icon`, `root`, `titles`

## populate()

`{ description?, heading?, icon? }`

Its declared props by name: `label` sets data-label.
